- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md (mirror: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md)
  Line or code reference: line 31, the "Build the in-flight footprint" bullet, clause (b)
  Problem: Clause (b) instructs the executor to build the footprint of un-dispatched waves from "the project's source plan — read that plan doc (the tracking issue names it)". For orchestrator tracking issues that were created from a plain issue rather than from a `docs/plans/*.md` document (the orchestrator accepts any issue as project input), no source plan doc exists, and the command defines no fallback for how to footprint such a project.
  Why it fails at runtime: The executor either wastes effort hunting for a nonexistent plan doc, or silently builds an incomplete footprint; since rules line 90–91 make the gate a hard gate and demand evidence-based screening, an under-specified footprint path lets an UNSCREENED-in-practice pick be reported as conflict-free. A one-clause fallback (e.g., "if no source plan doc exists, use the tracking issue body and its wave-issue scopes") closes the gap.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
